name: nft-flush-ruleset-peer-drops
description: same ruleset flush as nft-flush-restores, while the far end drops independently; ceiling case: the far end filters independently and that never reaches local capture
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
peer_setup: nft add chain inet p out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet p out ip daddr 10.5.5.1 drop
